title: Development and Characterization of Chitosan Nanoparticles Containing Quercetin-β-Cyclodextrin Inclusion Complex for Improved Solubility, Brain Targeting, and Neuroprotective Potential Against Epilepsy | AAPS PharmSciTech | Springer Nature Link

The present study focuses on developing and optimising chitosan nanoparticles containing quercetin-β-cyclodextrin inclusion complex (QNPs) using the nanoprecipitation method to enhance quercetin's solubility, stability, and bioavailability. A comprehensive optimization study revealed that Batch B6, which utilized ethanol as the solvent, poloxamer 188 as the stabilizer, and chitosan at a concentration of 0.2% (w/v), exhibits optimal characteristics required for providing a stable colloidal system.
